summary: Explain the authored part hierarchy of a small speaker through reversible separation.
objective: Build a portable speaker with a grille, driver, enclosure and back cover that I can separate and reassemble.
example_prompts: Build a portable speaker with a grille, driver, enclosure and back cover that I can separate and reassemble.
Select each speaker part and show its original seat.

entities.name: Enclosure and cover
entities.guidance: Shell has wall thickness, lip, screw bosses and matching rear cover seats; avoid a solid cube interior.

entities.name: Driver and grille
entities.guidance: Separate cone, surround, basket and perforated grille; align central axes.

entities.name: Fasteners
entities.guidance: Give screws heads and insertion axes; preserve stable part identifiers.

object_craft.structure: Shell has wall thickness, lip, screw bosses and matching rear cover seats; avoid a solid cube interior.
object_craft.material: Matte polymer shell with rubber-looking feet.

object_craft.structure: Separate cone, surround, basket and perforated grille; align central axes.
object_craft.material: Paper-like cone, satin grille, subdued surround.

object_craft.structure: Give screws heads and insertion axes; preserve stable part identifiers.

state_contract.model: Authored assembly tree with rest transforms, per-part explode axes, explosion scalar and selection; no electrical/acoustic model.
state_contract.authority: Domain state owns identities, values and accepted transitions. Derive labels and meshes from that state; camera and display offsets are separate.
actions: Isolate a part and its seat.

invariants: Explosion zero restores every rest transform exactly.
Part identity, count and material survive isolation.
Exploded display offsets never alter assembly coordinates.
motion_guidance: Stagger cover and grille separation so hidden parts become visible before labels appear.
Companion Three.js tooling can implement hierarchy, ray picking and clipping; part placement remains domain data.
known_limits: Invented product architecture; not a manufacturer teardown, acoustic design or repair instruction.
Authored recipe only; runtime and rendered geometry checks have not run.
creative_affordances: Axial separation exposes the nested construction while keeping connector lines short.

colliders: None; swept display envelopes checked for confusing intersections.
contact: No assembly force or screw-thread simulation.
physical_contract.timestep: Use a declared fixed update step for changing model state; interpolate presentation only. Pause clears accumulated playback time.
checks: Zero explosion restores exact transforms; isolate preserves selection identity.
